description:
Implement ARM NEON SIMD kernels for AArch64 platforms (mobile, embedded, Apple Silicon, AWS Graviton). Cover logical operations (AND/OR/XOR), popcount, and PMULL carry-less multiplication. This extends the library's platform reach beyond x86_64.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Delivers “Add ARM NEON SIMD backend for AArch64” with the behavior, scope, evidence, and constraints described above.
title: Add ARM NEON SIMD backend for AArch64
